title: ProductUiDNA
description: A complete Product UI DNA document for an application instance. Composes a layout with pages and routes into a single UI surface definition.

layout.description: The structural shell all pages in this UI live within.

pages.description: The discrete screens that make up this UI, each mapped from a Resource.

routes.description: The URL patterns that resolve to pages in this UI.

workflows.description: Navigable groupings of Pages above the Page level — the user journeys this UI supports.

operations.description: The behavioral UIOperations of this UI — trigger plus effects describing what happens on user interaction.

layout.name: LendingDashboard
layout.description: Primary shell for the lending application.
